name: roughness_forecast
character: Partial-amplitude profiles and release times the score-side roughness forecast uses when an instrument preset has no measured `partials` list of its own. Every number is a starting value: measure the instrument with `roughness_forecast.py partials` and put the result in its preset.
provenance: STARTING VALUE: every profile is a working shape (a sawtooth-like fall for bowed and blown, a faster fall for plucked and struck), not a measurement of the SoundFont.

MEASURED in this repository: the General MIDI church organ pedal stem of the Antigravity project at 57.5 s had its sixth harmonic (440 Hz) about 20 dB above the others, which is why the church_organ profile peaks at the sixth partial; the other families have no measurement.
The pair model and the frame rule are the audio row's own (scripts/naturalness_check.py, knowledgebase/sound-design/roughness.md).
